content: Socket.IO is the recommended choice over raw ws or uWebSockets.js for a Kahoot-style quiz game: built-in room management maps directly onto game sessions, automatic reconnection handles flaky mobile wifi, and the @socket.io/redis-adapter gives first-class horizontal scaling. Raw ws is lighter (20-30% more msgs/sec, less memory) but requires building rooms/reconnect/broadcast-scaling manually. uWebSockets.js is for 10k+ concurrent connection extreme-performance cases, overkill here.
